title: Scroll to Bottom Shortcut for Terminal Output
body:
**Bug Description**
 Sometimes this thing will default to the top page of the terminal when my issue was at the bottom last page of the terminal if there were some kind of shortcut like page down or I use vim and shift G will take it to the bottom of the page. Either way, I have to start at the beginning and scroll multiple pages down to get to my error and then try to fix it.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 0.2.18
- Feedback ID: 98685ca7-ae06-4aae-96bf-266febecd6eb
author: mengeworkman
